en.headline: Labour Department to review heat-stress warning system after amber alert on record-hot day
en.dek: Unions and a former Observatory director criticised the system for remaining at the lowest amber level throughout Sunday’s all-time high of 36.9°C; the department said it will monitor operations and consider further refinements.
body: The Labour Department said it would closely monitor the operation of the Heat Stress at Work Warning system and examine whether further optimisation is needed, after the lowest-level amber alert stayed in force on Sunday despite Hong Kong recording its hottest day since temperature records began in 1884.

The Hong Kong Observatory headquarters logged 36.9 degrees Celsius, while Sheung Shui reached 39.8 degrees under the outer subsiding air of Severe Typhoon Dolphin. Construction unionists and former Observatory director Lam Chiu-ying argued that the amber warning understated the risk faced by outdoor workers and that thresholds for red and black alerts appear unrealistically high. The department has never issued a red or black warning since the system launched in 2023.

A Labour Department spokesman noted that relative humidity was lower than typical summer levels and wind conditions were favourable on Sunday, with Hong Kong Heat Index readings at most of the ten monitoring stations falling between 30 and 32. The department will continue to watch heat conditions and the warning system’s performance.

zh.headline: 破紀錄高溫僅發黃色工作暑熱警告 勞工處稱會檢視系統
zh.dek: 周日天文台錄36.9度破1884年有紀錄最高，勞工處全天只維持黃色工作暑熱警告，工會及前天文台台長批評門檻過高；處方表示會密切留意並檢視是否需進一步優化。
body: 勞工處表示，會密切留意暑熱天氣及「工作暑熱警告」系統的運作情况，檢視系統是否需要再作進一步優化。周日即使本港錄得1884年有紀錄以來最高氣溫，警告仍一直維持最低級別的黃色。
天文台總部錄得36.9度，上水更高見39.8度，受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響。建造業工會及前天文台台長林超英等批評黃色警告未能反映戶外工人面對的風險，並指紅色及黑色警告門檻過高，系統自2023年推出以來從未發出紅或黑警告。
勞工處發言人指出，周日相對濕度低於夏季平常水平，風速條件良好，十個監測站大部分香港暑熱指數介乎30至32，故按機制發出黃色警告。處方會繼續留意暑熱天氣及系統運作。
